5.english_reference: Thus will I bless thee while I live

traditions.KJV: Thus will I bless thee while I live :

5.english_reference: I will lift up my hands in thy name

traditions.VUL: et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas .

6.english_reference: My soul shall be satisfied as [ with ] marrow and fatness

traditions.KJV: My soul shall be satisfied as [ with ] marrow and fatness ;

6.english_reference: and my mouth shall praise [ thee ] with joyful lips

traditions.WLC: וְ שִׂפְתֵ֥י רְ֝נָנ֗וֹת יְהַלֶּל פִּֽ י

traditions.VUL: et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum .
traditions.KJV: and my mouth shall praise [ thee ] with joyful lips :

7.english_reference: When I remember thee upon my bed

traditions.WLC: אִם זְכַרְתִּ֥י ךָ עַל יְצוּעָ֑ י
traditions.LXX: εἰ ἐμνημόνευόν σου ἐπὶ τῆς στρωμνῆς μου ,
traditions.VUL: Si memor fui tui super stratum meum ,

7.english_reference: [and] meditate on thee in the [ night ] watches

traditions.WLC: בְּ֝ אַשְׁמֻר֗וֹת אֶהְגֶּה בָּֽ ךְ

traditions.KJV: meditate on thee in the [ night ] watches .

8.english_reference: Because thou hast been my help

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָ ה לִּ֑ י
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐγενήθης βοηθός μου ,
traditions.KJV: Because thou hast been my help ,

8.english_reference: therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ צֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣י ךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן

traditions.KJV: therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice .

9.english_reference: My soul followeth hard after thee

traditions.WLC: דָּבְקָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣ י אַחֲרֶ֑י ךָ

traditions.KJV: My soul followeth hard after thee :

traditions.WLC: בִּ֝֗ י תָּמְכָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽ ךָ

10.english_reference: But those [ that ] seek my soul , to destroy [ it ]

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵ֗מָּה לְ֭ שׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑ י
traditions.LXX: αὐτοὶ δὲ εἰς μάτην ἐζήτησαν τὴν ψυχήν μου ,
traditions.VUL: Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam ,
traditions.KJV: But those [ that ] seek my soul , to destroy [ it ] ,

10.english_reference: shall go into the lower parts of the earth

traditions.WLC: יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּֽ תַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת הָ אָֽרֶץ

traditions.KJV: They shall fall by the sword :

12.english_reference: every one that sweareth by him shall glory

traditions.KJV: every one that sweareth by him shall glory :

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י יִ֝סָּכֵ֗ר פִּ֣י דֽוֹבְרֵי שָֽׁקֶר
